subject.title: fix(models): preserve audio and video input modalities

question: Should OpenClaw land this broader audio/video input widening branch, land the proof-positive sibling after porting broader preservation surfaces, or reject widening in favor of catalog clamping?
rationale: The branch is a plausible bug fix but expands a compatibility-sensitive provider/model metadata contract and overlaps with a smaller proof-positive PR, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent contract scope.

options.title: Land this broader branch after proof
options.body: Require current-head real loader proof for this PR, then land the wider preservation coverage as the canonical fix.

options.title: Port broader coverage to sibling
options.body: Use the proof-positive sibling as the landing path only after porting or explicitly rejecting this PR's extra catalog-core, static-catalog, inline-provider, and provider-discovery coverage.

options.title: Clamp instead of widen
options.body: Reject audio/video as accepted model metadata and replace the widening PRs with generated-catalog normalization that drops unsupported modalities before validation.

recommendation.title: Port broader coverage to sibling
recommendation.body: Use the proof-positive sibling as the landing path only after porting or explicitly rejecting this PR's extra catalog-core, static-catalog, inline-provider, and provider-discovery coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans model-catalog-core, LLM contract, and registry boundaries where steipete has the strongest recent history signal.
